notes.title: Fruit Hoop 2 is coming...
notes.content: [h2]🍌 The fruit are falling again... and they’re not alone.[/h2][p]Congratulations. You survived the fruitpocalypse. But now they’re back. And this time… they brought friends.[/p][p][b]Fruit Hoop 2[/b] is the mind-meltingly ridiculous sequel to the indie classic [i]Fruit Hoop[/i]. You once again take control of a hoop—yes, just a hoop—on an eternal mission to catch falling produce and dodge anything that wants you dead. But now, there are more fruits. More hazards. More bananas. So many bananas.[/p][p][/p][h2]🫐 [b]Still Not Convinced?[/b][/h2][list][*][p]It’s like [i]Frogger[/i] had a baby with a blender.[/p][/*][*][p]Minimal narrative, maximum vibes.[/p][/*][*][p]Designed for that “one more try” loop that ruins sleep schedules.[/p][/*][*][p]No microtransactions. Only macrofruit.[/p][/*][/list][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1477030/Fruit_Hoop_2/"][/dynamiclink][/p]
